discussion: The constructor evidence shows ConfigParser() defaults to allow_no_value=False, so the bare 'option' line would not be admitted as a valueless option; the parser would record ordinary parsing errors instead of reaching cursect[optname] is None, and the indented continuation would not raise MultilineContinuationError. The correction is to construct the parser with allow_no_value=True before invoking read_string.

operation.new:
def test_multilinecontinuationerror(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser(allow_no_value=True)
        with self.assertRaises(configparser.ParsingError) as ctx:
            parser.read_string('[section]\noption\n    continuation', source='test.cfg')
        exc = ctx.exception
        self.assertIsInstance(exc, configparser.MultilineContinuationError)
        self.assertEqual(exc.source, 'test.cfg')
        self.assertEqual(exc.lineno, 3)
        self.assertEqual(exc.line, '    continuation')
        self.assertEqual(exc.args, ('test.cfg', 3, '    continuation'))
        self.assertEqual(exc.errors, [(3, '    continuation')])
